name: Hitori no Qualia
source:
The mysterious girl Karin saved Makiri who carelessly walked out into the road. Makiri showered her with thanks, but it was a bit too close for Karin who refrained from interacting with others. However, Makiri’s purity helped Karin open her heart to her. Afterwards, they started living together. That’s when Karin found out that Makiri didn’t go to school and just played games all day. She decided to help her new friend who’s a hikikomori beyond her imagination by all means possible.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/03/01/march-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
神秘少女卡琳救了不小心走到路上的真切里。玛奇里向她表示感谢，但对于克琳来说，这有点太亲密了，她没有与其他人互动。然而，玛奇里的纯洁帮助卡琳向她敞开了心扉。之后，他们开始同居。就在那时，卡琳发现玛奇里没有去上学，只是整天玩游戏。她决定尽一切可能帮助她的新朋友——超出她想象的蛰居族。

[来自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/03/01/march-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
